plan.purpose: Check common Spark runtime compatibility and typed calls before fixing primary model comparison.
plan.warmup: One fixed Hello message with max_tokens=8, recorded separately; not an incident trial
plan.stopping: Exactly two cases per model; no retry or prompt tuning. Preserve runtime incompatibility and fit failures.
plan.gpu_measurement: Device-wide used MiB and compute processes sampled every 0.5 seconds. Preserve background workload; not isolated model VRAM or guaranteed instantaneous peak.
plan.analysis: Retain both planned rows including setup/runtime failure, raw responses and canonical proposals, read/repair evidence, final outcome, safety unknown, times, tokens and GPU samples. No ranking from this preflight.
plan.input_nondeterminism: Record request/call IDs and full HTTP payloads rather than reusing security nonces. Temperature zero is not a claim of identical runtime state.
plan.prior_cases: Existing healthy and stopped service development cases, not unused.
plan.hardware_setting: 16 GPU layers selected before execution to leave room for the existing ~1398 MiB background workload on GTX1650 4GiB. Remaining layers use CPU. This is not full-offload fit evidence and is not directly comparable to LFM99-layer timings.
plan.comparison: Both candidate models use the same runtime overlay, offload, reasoning settings, generation and task prompt as the Spark availability setting.
plan.system_prompt_suffix: Task-specific completion contract: This availability task checks whether the affected logical service or container is running. First obtain service_status for the affected service or docker_status for the affected container. plan.scope: Two existing clean availability development cases; compatibility preflight only, not HTTP primary evaluation or ranking.

provenance.selection: Prior thinking smoke reached typed calls and availability recovery; keep background GPU services running and use 16-layer offload. HTTP behavior is unproven.

plan.checkpoint_policy: Save active trial before setup, before each model send and after response or error. Added checkpoint I/O is part of this development run timing; prior interrupted ablation remains unchanged.
plan.ordering: Healthy then stopped, one model load. Agents then Granite; preflight only, not comparative primary data.
